scope: All governed rows inventoried; licensed desktop implementation remains external. Source review does not qualify a candidate or change supported scope.

findings.title: MCP error and cancellation negative controls accept unexpected success
findings.impact: Both checks catch their own unexpected-success exceptions. Controlled broken client yielded pass and process exit 0. Other missing operation receipts still prevent full release acceptance.
findings.acceptance: Keep success-path failure outside catch; assert the expected protocol/abort error and prove the controls fail against deliberately broken behavior.

findings.title: OpenLayers line and polygon certification uses point marker pixels
findings.impact: Line and fill certificate IDs can pass without LineString or Polygon rendering.
findings.acceptance: Add actual line and polygon fixtures with distinct colors and independent pixel/geometry assertions; keep the corresponding facets incomplete until exercised.

findings.title: Python client append certification reuses applyEdits; edit checks lack readback
findings.impact: Append can pass without calling append. Edit success booleans cannot detect acknowledged but unpersisted writes.
findings.acceptance: Call the actual supported append API or classify its client applicability honestly; independently query added/updated/deleted state.

findings.title: MCP and .NET producer receipt schemas do not meet release v2 contract
findings.impact: Successful execution still emits v1 receipts rejected by the current release consumer.
findings.acceptance: Emit v2 governed requirement context from producers and run a real producer-to-consumer contract check; do not loosen consumer validation.

findings.title: Canonical producer registry is incomplete and partially stale
findings.impact: General interop nightly builds its own image; the exact-image 52-cell bounded roster is not registered here. SDK-JS candidate inputs now exist despite an unproduced disposition saying they do not. Catalog counts measure registration, not executed coverage or approved release scope.
findings.acceptance: Reconcile the approved .1 roster, dispatch existing exact-image harnesses, and join their actual receipts. Explicitly adjudicate aliases/non-addressable rows instead of treating all catalog rows as new implementation work.

findings.title: Executable breadth remains incomplete for MCP and Python SDK
findings.impact: Current MCP builder permits only four operations per client; synthetic all-success transport controls produce eight pass and 76 skip rows. Python trunk still declares missing required gRPC unary/streaming and FeatureServer edits.
findings.acceptance: Complete required semantic workflows with typed outputs, auth denial, cancellation and readback. Python operation implementation is already assigned to the active release agent.

findings.title: OWSLib expired-token expectation contradicts current WMS auth formatter
findings.impact: Latest inspected run expected HTTP 200 InvalidParameterValue while current formatter intentionally returns HTTP 401 AccessDenied. The separately adjudicated DuckDB CRS issue is tracked as NC-12.
findings.acceptance: Update to the intended authentication contract while retaining challenge and no-data assertions; DuckDB storage-versus-wire semantics remain independently tracked by NC-12.

findings.title: Interop lane omits the dedicated rendering command and discards test exit codes
findings.impact: Dedicated OpenLayers rendering runs in full CI, but the separate interop lane runs only Vitest and a different browser suite and masks nonzero test exits.
findings.acceptance: Run actual rendering in interop, preserve evidence, and return failure when any suite fails.

findings.title: Full-matrix gate trusts a public run URL without authenticating the check publisher or executed jobs
findings.impact: A controlled skipped Python job failed as intended, but appending an unrelated-app check with the expected name and the same public Actions URL changed the verdict to pass. This does not establish that a real candidate was accepted incorrectly.
findings.acceptance: Require authentic Actions app and selected check suite, exact source identity, actual required jobs and successful test steps. Retain provenance across failed-job reruns and reject unrelated publishers, skipped execution and incomplete shard coverage.

findings.title: A selected server shard can report success after executing no tests
findings.impact: The shard runner propagates the test process exit code without requiring a positive executed-test count. A successful job or step alone cannot distinguish execution from an unmatched filter.
findings.acceptance: Reject missing, empty, all-skipped and stale TRX results, enable no-match failure, preserve executed counters and digest, and verify a real unmatched filter exits nonzero.

findings.title: MCP cancellation notifications do not cancel an in-flight server request
findings.impact: The dispatcher returns without acting on notifications/cancelled. A client-side aborted ping cannot prove server cessation. Stateless clients, request-ID collisions and multi-replica delivery need explicit semantics.
findings.acceptance: Implement safe principal/session/request-scoped cancellation and prove actual server work stops while unrelated requests continue. Preserve race/cleanup safety and multi-replica guarantees; durable GP cancellation remains a separate workflow proof.

findings.title: DuckDB metadata assertions confuse published CRS84 with the physical PostGIS SRID
findings.impact: Nightly 39028726113 reports two failures because the fixture publishes CRS84 and the real client reports OGC:CRS84 while assertions insist on EPSG:4326. Other axis-order tests remain discriminating.
findings.acceptance: Assert exact CRS84 metadata and typed geometry with known longitude/latitude anchor; preserve explicit EPSG:4326 axis and projected-coordinate checks and reject wrong-CRS or swapped-coordinate controls.

local_execution.rule: Same commands and identities; retained logs and all attempts. Existing authenticated consumers remain authoritative.
local_execution.remaining: A local runner may substitute only where the trusted receipt contract supports it; never fabricate Actions run IDs or replace real AWS proofs with container results.

observed_source_checks.method: Catalog proving_tests evaluated through scripts/ci/capability-impact.py shard_names_for_test against .github/ci-shards.json at the same source revision.
observed_source_checks.limit: Static declared references only; does not prove runtime discovery, trait selection, assertion quality or execution.
